Alex: Tiny confession — swapped the office gnome for a rubber duck this morning. Felt oddly productive afterward. Who else has micro-pranks / tiny good surprises around the office? :duck:
Priya: OMG that explains the squeaking near the ficus. :laughing:
Mateo: I once labeled everyone's keyboard 'Emperor's Keyboard' for a week. 10% morale boost, scientifically unverified.
Jordan: not a prank but I sneak-post sticky motivational notes on people's monitors. current fav: "You are doing the thing."
Casey: I put a bowl of fortune cookies in the kitchen. No fortunes, just compliments. :heart:
Lina: vote: replace gnome with tiny succulent permanently? :seedling:
Alex: quick poll — reply with 1️⃣ keep gnome, 2️⃣ duck forever, 3️⃣ succulent coup
Priya: 2️⃣ (duck forever) — the squeak is now iconic.
Mateo: 3️⃣ (succulent) — low maintenance mayor.
Jordan: 1️⃣ — gnome deserves a second chance.
Casey: 2️⃣ — also can we name the duck "Latency"? :duck:
SamBot: Reminder: Kitchen supplies restock tomorrow at 10am. :bell:
Alex: also, kudos to @Priya for the surprise bagels today. :clap:
Priya: thanks! brought extras. please help yourself.
Lina: tiny brag: my plant learned to photobomb Zoom calls. photo incoming.
Jordan: post the pic! :camera: 
Mateo: This thread is my daily micro-sunshine. :sun_with_face:
